title: Hall of Fame moves on from 19 selectors

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Hall of Fame moves on from 19 selectors
sources.description: Earlier this month, on the Friday before Labor Day weekend, the Pro Football Hall of Fame announced a significant overhaul to the selection process, which was undoubtedly sparked by the inexplicable failure of Bill Belichick to secure enshrinement in his first year of eligibility.
